english.title: Fail to ensure recording apparatus satisfies requirements in relation to air traffic service equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of air traffic service equipment for which recording apparatus was required to be provided under article 206(2) or (3) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed to ensure that

(A)_[when operated the apparatus was capable of recording and replaying the terms or content of any message or signal transmitted or received by or through that equipment]_
(B)_[, in the case of an aeronautical radio station, the apparatus was capable of recording and replaying the terms or content of any voice radio message or signal transmitted to an aircraft either alone or in common with other aircraft or received from an aircraft by the air traffic control unit]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 206(4) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a person in charge of air traffic service equipment for which recording apparatus was required to be provided
under article 206(2) or (3) of the Order, failed to ensure that
when operated the apparatus was capable of recording and replaying the terms or content of any message or signal transmitted or received by or through that equipment AND
in the case of an aeronautical radio station, the apparatus was capable of recording and replaying the terms or content of any voice radio message or signal transmitted to an aircraft either alone or in common with other aircraft or received from an aircraft by the air traffic control unit
